answers.question: Show the names of conductors and the orchestras they have conducted.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT c.name AS conductor_name, o.orchestra FROM conductor c JOIN orchestra o ON c.conductor_id = o.conductor_id

answers.question: What are the names of conductors as well as the corresonding orchestras that they have conducted?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT c.name, o.orchestra FROM conductor c JOIN orchestra o ON c.conductor_id = o.conductor_id

answers.question: Show the names of conductors that have conducted more than one orchestras.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT concat.c FROM (SELECT conduct.conductor_id, count(distinct per.orchestra_id) AS num_orchestras FROM conductor conduct JOIN performance per ON conduct.conductor_id = per.orchestra_id WHERE conduct.conductor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY conduct.conductor_id HAVING num_orchestras > 1) AS concat

answers.question: Show the name of the conductor that has conducted the most number of orchestras.
answers.generated_answer: Select name from conductor Group by conductor_id Having Count(distinct orchestra.orchestra_id) = ( Select max(count(distinct o.orchestra_id)) From conductor C2 Join Orchestra O2 on C2.conductor_id = o2.conductor_id Group by C2.conductor_id)

answers.question: Please show the name of the conductor that has conducted orchestras founded after 2008.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT name FROM conductor WHERE conductor_id IN (SELECT conductor_id FROM orchestra WHERE year_of_founded > 2008)

answers.question: How many orchestras does each record company manage?
Please show the record formats of orchestras in ascending order of count.
answers.generated_answer: Select major_record_format from orchestra group by major_record_format order by count(*) asc

answers.question: What is the record company used by the greatest number of orchestras?
answers.generated_answer: select record_company from orchestra group by record_company order by count(*) desc limit 1

answers.question: What are the orchestras that do not have any performances?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT * FROM orchestra WHERE orchestra_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT orchestra_id FROM performance)

answers.question: What are the record companies that are used by both orchestras founded before 2003 and those founded after 2003?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT record_company FROM orchestra WHERE year_of_founded < 2003 OR year_of_founded > 2003
